items.headline: CENTCOM confirms U.S. strikes on three Iranian crude carriers, removing prior attribution uncertainty
items.summary: U.S. Central Command confirmed that U.S. forces struck three Iranian crude-oil carriers after Iranian ballistic-missile attacks on two U.S. Navy ships. No U.S. personnel were reported injured.
items.whyItMatters: The prior AGCI cut treated tanker-strike attribution near Iran as unconfirmed. Confirmation raises the probability that energy transportation itself remains inside the military escalation path, sustaining a higher oil-risk premium and inflation tail risk.
items.agciSignal: ATTRIBUTION CONFIRMED / ENERGY TRANSPORT AT RISK / KEEP MODERATE HEDGE

items.headline: OPEC+ keeps October output policy unchanged despite Hormuz disruption
items.summary: OPEC+ decided on September 6 to keep its oil-output policy unchanged for October while the Iran conflict and Hormuz restrictions continue to impair physical exports and leave several producers below target.
items.whyItMatters: No incremental policy supply cushion is being introduced now. With disrupted barrels constraining effective supply, AGCI treats OPEC+ capacity as less able to offset the geopolitical shock than headline quotas imply.
items.agciSignal: NO NEW OPEC+ CUSHION / PHYSICAL FLOWS DOMINATE QUOTAS

items.headline: Iran acknowledges worsening economic strain while warning retaliation could intensify
items.summary: Iranian officials pledged domestic economic measures as sanctions, oil-export restrictions and conflict pressure deepen inflation, currency and import stress; senior officials also warned that further U.S. attacks would trigger a faster and more painful response.
items.whyItMatters: Economic pressure may increase incentives for negotiation, but near-term retaliation risk remains elevated. AGCI therefore separates medium-term bargaining leverage from immediate military tail risk.
items.agciSignal: ECONOMIC PRESSURE RISING / NEGOTIATION OPTIONALITY UP / RETALIATION RISK STILL HIGH

items.headline: Greed holds at 81 while Valuation remains 85 and regime stays Correction
items.summary: The live AGCI engine remains at Greed 81/100, Valuation 85/100, Correction regime and EUPHORIA_RISK / Capital preservation — Do not chase; one-day Greed change is zero.
items.whyItMatters: The weekend geopolitical escalation has not produced a new market-price observation. AGCI therefore does not manufacture a sentiment reset and keeps liquidity plus staged entries unchanged.
items.agciSignal: SCORES UNCHANGED / CORRECTION / VALUATION STILL EXTREME
